messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Incident opened: Dedicated capacity saturation detected — eu-west-1 / pool-ded-37. Automatic paging triggered due to sustained p99 > 2.5s for 3m. Pager: @oncall-pager

sam: ack. I'm on it. seeing p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 2.7s for streaming endpoints. non-streaming generation p99 ~ 1.1s.

priya: thanks. are we seeing queue buildup or backpressure at the router?

sam: queue depth on pool-ded-37 jumped to 1.2k (normal < 150). Warmup success rate dipped to 38% for new nodes. autoscaler logs show repeated handshake timeouts: 
```
2026-03-15T12:03:22Z autoscaler: probe -> pool-ded-37 node-launch ok? false handshake_timeout
2026-03-15T12:03:37Z warmup: init_model_failed id=node-7 reason=kv_cache_miss_warmup
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z router: queue_depth=1187 inflight=120 active_nodes=6 optimal=18
```

neha: kv cache coldpath? that explains streaming stalls — lots of tail latency from cache warmups. which model(s) impacted?

sam: mostly open-llama-13b-q4 and a few customer-pinned variants. hotshot pools are at 90% too because several routed customers are priority.

ryan: checking autoscaler metric stream — saw probe failures when image pulled from private registry timed out (network flakiness in eu-west-1). Some nodes ended up not completing warmup and remained unhealthy.

maria: customer impact: support reports 3 enterprise customers with visible failures (error 503) and many more with high latency. Sent initial notice to customers A (SaaScom), C (FinApp), and internal CSMs.

sam: mitigation plan (short):
- 1) Temporarily relax routing: move priority-1 traffic off pool-ded-37 -> hotshot-eu for 15m.
- 2) Enable degraded-mode for streaming: fall back to non-streaming generation for requests larger than 1k tokens.
- 3) Force-scale pool-ded-37 min=12 (currently 6) and trigger manual warmup for new nodes.
- 4) Bypass autoscaler probe gate for next 2 launches (unsafe but needed) to get nodes into warmup.

priya: +1 to all. Sam — can you run the routing move and scaling? I'll take hotshot config and update support notes.

sam: doing it now. commands: 
```
# increase min size and force warmup
rictl pools set-scale --pool pool-ded-37 --min 12 --max 64 --reason "incident emergency" --force-warmup
# reroute priority1 -> hotshot-eu
rictl routing set-rule --match "tag:priority=1" --route hotshot-eu --duration 900
# enable degraded streaming fallback
rictl features set --feature streaming_degrade_threshold --value 1000
```

incident-bot: Deployment queued: rictl operations submitted (op-84422). ETA for scale actions 40-90s.

neha: started manual warmup probe on node-9, node-10; logs look better after forcing KVs to prefetch. Warmup success on node-10 -> true.

ryan: registry connectivity showing intermittent spikes around 12:02-12:06Z. infra alerted and rotation started on manifest mirror. Might be root cause of handshake timeouts.

sam: initial results: after reroute and forced warmup, queue depth dropped to ~220 in 4m, p99 trending down to 1.1s for streaming, p95 ~ 380ms. Still elevated vs normal but moving in right direction.

maria: update sent to customers: "Mitigation in progress — rerouting high-priority traffic and scaling pool. Expect degraded streaming behavior for next 15–30 minutes. We'll share a full RCA."

oncall-pager: paging reminder — Priya will take lead at 12:20Z for the handoff. Sam please document follow-ups.

priya: taking lead. can someone capture the incident timeline and open a ticket for long-term fixes? I will create a follow-up ticket for autoscaler probe resilience + registry mirror config.

sam: opened ticket: INC-2026-8421 with description: "autoscaler probe timeouts causing failed warmup -> dedicated pool saturation. Investigate registry mirror fallback and increase probe retries / exponential backoff. Add warmup prefetch for KV cache on new nodes." Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-8421

neha: quick note for SLO reporting: p99 breach window ~ 12:01Z - 12:18Z, peak p99 2.78s. total error rate spike +4.9% in that window.

priya: handoff checklist for me:
- validate reroute maintained (rictl routing status)
- monitor warmup success per node (warmup_success_rate > 80% target)
- confirm customer notices sent and support escalation closed
- attach logs to INC-2026-8421

sam: added a small emergency fallback in routing to prefer smaller-quantized variants of the model for non-enterprise customers; buying headroom.

ryan: infra update: registry mirror rotation completed at 12:09Z, subsequent launches show image pull latency < 150ms. Recommend tuning autoscaler probe-window to tolerate short registry blips.

maria: support update: customers A and C confirmed reduced errors, FinApp reported faster retries fixed symptoms. Ops will follow up with credits if SLA hit confirmed.

priya: status at 12:20Z handoff: p99 streaming ~ 0.95s, p95 ~ 330ms, queue depth ~ 90. Warmup success rate 87% over last 5m. Continuing monitoring 1h.

sam: root-cause hypotheses to investigate postmortem: (a) registry mirror flakiness caused autoscaler probe failures -> failed warmup; (b) lack of warmup prefetch for KV cache on new nodes produced streaming tail latency; (c) routing concentration on pool-ded-37 amplified impact (too many priority routes pinned).

priya: actions assigned:
- sam: collect autoscaler logs + node warmup traces and attach to INC-2026-8421 (due EOD).
- neha: add KV prefetch pilot for warmup pipeline and benchmark (due next week).
- ryan: add guardrails to autoscaler: retry/backoff and temporary mirror fallback (due 2 weeks).
- maria: follow up on customer credits and CSM notes (ongoing).

oncall-pager: handoff recorded. Priya is oncall lead. Closing active page; will re-open if p99 > 1.5s for 5m.

priya: thanks everyone. leaving monitoring on. will post follow-up in INC-2026-8421 with a timeline and recommended mitigations once root-cause validated. :thumbsup:
